name: Pirate Cove Simulator
storyline:
Yo ho ho
Welcome to your Pirate Cove
You were a pirate captain
But you've sailed into a storm
Your ship is wrecked
Your crew's dead too
And frankly so are you
So now you're stuck in afterlife
What will you ever do?

Yo ho ho
You're stuck in the Pirate Cove

On this island full of wonders
You can set up your own shop
Cause even undead pirates
Still need their rum and grog
Every gold coin that you make
Will help you lift the curse
So run your distillery, mate
Hey it could have been much worse

Yo ho ho
You'll be running the Pirate Cove

The sea is full of fish to catch
And there's treasure to be found
You'll buy your way out and cheat death
But you might choose to stick around
The pirate's afterlife is easy
Cause your rum is never gone
And you'll be getting richer
At the Pirate Cove
The magical Pirate Cove!
summary: Pirate Cove Simulator will have you run a shop and tavern on the Island of the Damned, to get rich and buy your way out of the pirate afterlife. Trade with restless undead pirates, run your own distillery and turn local plants into potent drinks, search for hidden treasures, or just go fishing.
